name: project_player_desktop
description: A multi-modal streaming player for local resources
author: Isshin Player Team

scripts.desktop:build:mac: node scripts/bump-patch-version.mjs && node scripts/ensure-desktop-platform.mjs mac && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/verify-tauri-acl.mjs && tauri build --bundles app,dmg && node scripts/print-desktop-artifacts.mjs mac
scripts.desktop:build:mac:intel: node scripts/bump-patch-version.mjs && node scripts/ensure-desktop-platform.mjs mac && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/verify-tauri-acl.mjs && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg && node scripts/print-desktop-artifacts.mjs mac-intel
scripts.desktop:build:win: node scripts/bump-patch-version.mjs && node scripts/ensure-desktop-platform.mjs win && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/verify-tauri-acl.mjs && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi && node scripts/print-desktop-artifacts.mjs win
